title: "Stage 1b: Parse Ballotpedia recall data from HTML cache"
execute:
  cache: false
---

```{r}
#| label: purpose
#| include: false
# =============================================================================
# Purpose : Parse cached Ballotpedia HTML into a clean recalls dataset.
# Inputs  : data/raw/ballotpedia/html/*.html (individual recall pages)
# Outputs : data/raw/ballotpedia/recalls_raw.rds
# =============================================================================
```

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

here::i_am("_quarto.yml")

html_dir <- here("data", "raw", "ballotpedia", "html")
stopifnot(dir.exists(html_dir))
```

## Enumerate recall pages

```{r}
#| label: list-files
all_files <- list.files(html_dir, pattern = "\\.html$", full.names = TRUE)

# Exclude the 11 year-summary pages (filenames are just "YYYY.html")
is_year_summary <- str_detect(basename(all_files), "^\\d{4}\\.html$")
recall_files <- all_files[!is_year_summary]

cat(sprintf("Total HTML files:     %d\n", length(all_files)))
cat(sprintf("Year summary pages:   %d\n", sum(is_year_summary)))
cat(sprintf("Individual recalls:   %d\n", length(recall_files)))
```

## Parser

```{r}
#| label: parser
# Parse one recall page and return a 1-row tibble.
parse_one <- function(path) {
  raw <- paste(readLines(path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"), collapse = "\n")

  # ---- Title -----------------------------------------------------------------
  title <- str_match(raw, regex("<title>(.*?)</title>", dotall = TRUE))[, 2]
  # Trim the trailing " - Ballotpedia"
  title_clean <- str_remove(title, "\\s*-\\s*Ballotpedia\\s*$")

  # Two title shapes: "<official> recall, <city>, <state> (<years>)" and the
  # older city-less "<official> recall, <state> (<years>)".

  m_full <- str_match(
    title_clean,
    "^(.*?) recall,\\s*(.+?),\\s*([^,()]+?)\\s*\\((\\d{4}(?:-\\d{4})?)\\)\\s*$"
  )
  m_nocity <- str_match(
    title_clean,
    "^(.*?) recall,\\s*([^,()]+?)\\s*\\((\\d{4}(?:-\\d{4})?)\\)\\s*$"
  )

  if (!is.na(m_full[1, 1])) {
    official <- m_full[1, 2]; city <- m_full[1, 3]
    state    <- m_full[1, 4]; year_range <- m_full[1, 5]
    title_parse_status <- "full"
  } else if (!is.na(m_nocity[1, 1])) {
    official <- m_nocity[1, 2]; city <- NA_character_
    state    <- m_nocity[1, 3]; year_range <- m_nocity[1, 4]
    title_parse_status <- "nocity"
  } else {
    official <- NA_character_; city <- NA_character_
    state <- NA_character_; year_range <- NA_character_
    title_parse_status <- "failed"
  }

  # ---- Year range → filing_year / decision_year ------------------------------
  years <- str_split(year_range, "-")[[1]]
  filing_year   <- if (length(years) >= 1) suppressWarnings(as.integer(years[1])) else NA_integer_
  decision_year <- if (length(years) == 2) suppressWarnings(as.integer(years[2])) else filing_year

  # ---- wgCategories JS array ------------------------------------------------
  cats_raw <- str_match(raw, regex('"wgCategories"\\s*:\\s*\\[(.*?)\\]', dotall = TRUE))[, 2]
  if (is.na(cats_raw)) cats_raw <- ""
  cats_vec <- str_extract_all(cats_raw, '"[^"]+"')[[1]] |>
    str_remove_all('"')

  # ---- Outcome classification ------------------------------------------------
  # Priority: approved > resigned > defeated > did not go to a vote > multiple > underway
  # (if multiple outcome tags present – multi-target pages – flag separately)
  has <- function(x) any(str_detect(cats_vec, fixed(x, ignore_case = TRUE)))

  outcome_tags <- cats_vec[str_starts(cats_vec, "Recall, ") &
                             !str_detect(cats_vec,
                                         "^Recall, \\d{4}$|^Recall, [A-Z][a-z]+ [A-Z][a-z]+$|^Recall, [A-Z][a-z]+$|^Recall, judicial$")]
  # That pattern strips out year-tags, state-tags, and "Recall, judicial".

  outcome <- case_when(
    has("Recall, approved")           ~ "Removed",
    has("Recall, resigned")           ~ "Resigned",
    has("Recall, defeated")           ~ "Defeated",
    has("Recall, did not go to a vote") ~ "Did Not Make Ballot",
    has("Recall, multiple outcomes") ~ "Multiple Outcomes",
    has("Recall, underway")          ~ "Underway",
    TRUE                              ~ "Unknown"
  )

  # ---- Office type -----------------------------------------------------------
  office_type <- case_when(
    any(str_detect(cats_vec, "^Mayoral recalls,"))      &
      any(str_detect(cats_vec, "^City council recalls,")) ~ "Mayor + Council",
    any(str_detect(cats_vec, "^Mayoral recalls,"))       ~ "Mayor",
    any(str_detect(cats_vec, "^City council recalls,")) ~ "Council",
    any(str_detect(cats_vec, "^School board recalls,")) ~ "School Board",
    has("Recall, judicial")                               ~ "Judicial",
    TRUE                                                  ~ "Other"
  )

  tibble(
    slug          = str_remove(basename(path), "\\.html$"),
    title         = title_clean,
    title_parse_status = title_parse_status,
    official      = official,
    city          = city,
    state         = state,
    year_range    = year_range,
    filing_year   = filing_year,
    decision_year = decision_year,
    outcome       = outcome,
    office_type   = office_type,
    outcome_tags  = paste(outcome_tags, collapse = " | "),
    all_cats      = paste(cats_vec, collapse = " | ")
  )
}

recalls <- map_dfr(recall_files, parse_one, .progress = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("Parsed %d pages.\n", nrow(recalls)))
```

## Validation

### Title parse status

```{r}
#| label: val-title
recalls |> count(title_parse_status)
```

### Outcome distribution

```{r}
#| label: val-outcome
recalls |> count(outcome, sort = TRUE)
```

### Year distribution

```{r}
#| label: val-year
recalls |> count(filing_year, sort = FALSE)
```

### Office type distribution

```{r}
#| label: val-office
recalls |> count(office_type, sort = TRUE)
```

### Sanity check: city vs. state (should not swap)

```{r}
#| label: val-geo
# Lists of valid US state names for a quick check
us_states <- c(state.name, "District of Columbia", "Washington, D.C.")
recalls |>
  summarise(
    n_rows                 = n(),
    city_is_state_name     = sum(city %in% us_states, na.rm = TRUE),
    state_is_valid         = sum(state %in% us_states, na.rm = TRUE),
    state_is_missing       = sum(is.na(state)),
    state_not_us_state_name = sum(!is.na(state) & !(state %in% us_states))
  )

# Show examples of state values that aren't standard US state names
recalls |>
  filter(!is.na(state), !(state %in% us_states)) |>
  count(state, sort = TRUE) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

### Spot-check a few rows

```{r}
#| label: spot-check
recalls |>
  select(slug, official, city, state, filing_year, outcome, office_type) |>
  slice_sample(n = 12) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Write output

```{r}
#| label: write
out_path <- here("data", "raw", "ballotpedia", "recalls_raw.rds")
# Keep the core columns; drop the verbose diagnostic columns
recalls_out <- recalls |>
  select(slug, title, official, city, state,
         filing_year, decision_year, year_range,
         outcome, office_type,
         title_parse_status, outcome_tags)

saveRDS(recalls_out, out_path)
cat(sprintf("Wrote %s (%d rows, %d cols)\n",
            out_path, nrow(recalls_out), ncol(recalls_out)))
```

## Exit criteria

```{r}
#| label: exit-criteria
n_total   <- nrow(recalls)
n_four    <- sum(recalls$outcome %in% c("Removed", "Resigned", "Defeated", "Did Not Make Ballot"))
pct_unk   <- mean(recalls$outcome == "Unknown") * 100
city_bad  <- sum(recalls$city %in% state.name, na.rm = TRUE)
yr_spread <- range(recalls$filing_year, na.rm = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("- nrow > 400 ............ %s (%d)\n",     n_total > 400, n_total))
cat(sprintf("- 4 canonical outcomes .. %s (%d covered)\n",
            all(c("Removed","Resigned","Defeated","Did Not Make Ballot") %in% recalls$outcome),
            n_four))
cat(sprintf("- Unknown outcome < 5%% . %s (%.1f%%)\n", pct_unk < 5, pct_unk))
cat(sprintf("- city != state name .... %s (%d bad rows)\n", city_bad == 0, city_bad))
cat(sprintf("- year range ............ %d to %d\n", yr_spread[1], yr_spread[2]))
```
